title: 加州总检察长宣布派拉蒙反垄断和解 强调并非为合并开绿灯
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And we are here in Los Angeles, the beating heart of America's film and TV industry,
segments.zh: 我们此刻在洛杉矶，美国影视产业的核心地带，

segments.en: and I'm here to announce a settlement that our coalition of attorneys general has reached with Paramount that resolves the antitrust concerns at the heart of our lawsuit against the company
segments.zh: 我在此宣布，我们各州总检察长联盟已与派拉蒙达成和解，解决了针对该公司反垄断诉讼的核心关切，

segments.en: and Warner Brothers. This is a court enforceable settlement that addresses those concerns by providing more film production that protects Hollywood workers and their livelihoods that places guardrails
segments.zh: 以及华纳兄弟。这份可法院强制执行的和解协议通过增加电影制作、保护好莱坞从业者及其生计、设置护栏来回应这些关切，

segments.en: allowing for robust cable negotiations that protects competition and creates more choice for consumers about what this merger could mean for the industry. I want to be clear about something
segments.zh: 允许有力的有线电视谈判，保护竞争，为消费者创造更多选择，关于这笔合并对行业可能意味着什么。我想先说清楚一点，

segments.en: right up front. This settlement is not a vote of support for this merger. It is not a blessing
segments.zh: 这份和解并非对该合并的支持投票，也不是对更广泛合并的祝福。

segments.en: of the broader merger. Broadly speaking, we believe further consolidation in markets that are essential to American economic life. It doesn't serve the American economy, consumers, or
segments.zh: 总体而言，我们认为在对美国经济生活至关重要的市场中进一步整合，并不利于美国经济、消费者或竞争。

segments.en: competition well. Our record addressing mergers and consolidations, market concentrations
segments.zh: 我们在处理合并、整合和市场集中方面的记录，
